Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in the very first step by misidentifying the subject of the conversation. The user asked about "Icehouse pieces" (the pyramid-shaped gaming components invented in 1986/1987 and commercialized starting in 1989), but the Planner's internal reasoning and subsequent search instructions repeatedly confused this with "Icehouse" the band (an Australian rock/synthpop group formed in the early 1980s). This confusion led to searching for "Icehouse discography" and "Icehouse (band)" instead of focusing on the game components and their commercial release dates. This initial conceptual error skewed all subsequent search queries and prevented the accurate determination of the release date for the game pieces compared to Kill Doctor Lucky.
